notes: index-ja.html: contains the <head> "§8 safe language routing" localStorage redirect script, which the source comment says must run ONLY on the bare root page. Not copy, but a live-site behaviour worth a decision before Phase 2 (a saved non-ja preference would redirect visitors away from /ja/).

FAQ answers: each #faq-aN contains exactly one

in every locale, so the stored answer is that paragraph's innerHTML (wrapper recorded per entry as "via"). FAQ questions are the innerHTML of the text inside the button; the trailing was excluded and is listed under stripped decorations.

Managed facts: the <!--pdg:KEY-->value<!--/pdg--> marker comments are kept verbatim inside the extracted values (they are part of the source slice). The "managed" table lists which JSON paths embed which marker so Phase 2 can substitute facts.json at render time.
contact.messages.sending keeps the spinner <span class="spinner-border ..."> exactly as the inline script assigns it to innerHTML.

The CTA→interest preselection is not a JS map: the inline script copies the clicked anchor's data-interest attribute into #interest. contact.preselect lists those anchors (interest, section, source line) as found in the DOM.
console.warn/console.error/console.log literals in the inline scripts are developer-facing and were deliberately not extracted.
"ui" is empty in every locale: check C found no body text node outside the named keys.
Source observation (left untouched): en FAQ answer 3 reads "…ongoing support to support a successful integration." — repeated "support"; verify with the author before Phase 2 rather than editing.
Source observation (left untouched): the pricing feature "Vehicle & Travel Trained" uses a bare "&" in the HTML (browsers tolerate it); the same list elsewhere uses "&".
